title: Astra procedural prompt deletion ablation (explicit task scope)
hypothesis: Astra completes coding tasks at equal correctness and lower cost when nine accumulated discovery, rereading and round-trip prescriptions are removed from both prompt surfaces.
falsified_if: Workflow-lite loses correctness, has no repeatable efficiency gain, or increases recovery failures. A passing tiny smoke is not supporting evidence.
local_evidence: User-approved back-to-basics experiment, informed by https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model#prompting-best-practices. Exact deletions in evals/prompt_ablation.json. Existing lean/minimal profiles leave registry workflow rules intact and are not used. This tests a deletion bundle, not token length alone or individual rule effects. V1 was stopped for a task/grader mismatch: a new test file was not forbidden by the task but failed the grader. V2 freezes explicit file-scope suffixes identically for both arms, with request-level checks. Original scenario files, graders and prior raw evidence are unchanged.
deterministic_outcomes: original external hard gates and artifact behavioral gates reported separately
exact request prompt audit on every call
efficiency_outcomes: identical-read review candidates, not assumed wasted reads
actual baseline tool counts and multi-file coverage
decision_rule: Freeze seed 910; four independent smoke cells (simple_prompt and ambiguous_bug_investigation, both arms), then 54 pilot cells (nine scenarios, three repetitions, two arms). Maximum 58 launches, $12 between-run estimated cost threshold (may overshoot one run), 2400 active worker seconds. No automatic retries. Smoke task failures and all activation/protocol failures halt. All source/fixture/grader hashes pinned by campaign. Primary population is eight coding scenarios, excluding arithmetic and smoke. Continue to held-out validation only if workflow-lite has at least as many passes on every coding scenario, at least 15% lower aggregate coding cost, lower median cost on at least five of eight coding scenarios, and aggregate elapsed time no more than 10% worse. Otherwise do not change defaults: correctness regression rejects this bundle; unchanged/mixed efficiency is inconclusive. No early success claims or secondary-metric substitution. Preserve tool schemas, exact tagged-edit contract, current planner, verification sufficiency, project instructions, permissions, model/reasoning, normal retained history and engine settings. No external model judge. Cases include multi-file work, an injected regression, environmental recovery, a corrected conversation and smaller edit controls; existing archived baselines are mostly under 20 tools, so this is NOT the requested genuinely long 20+ tool cohort. A winning pilot still requires 20–50 held-out long tasks. Do not promote on three repeats or infer state-only/memory benefits. This is a fresh campaign after the v1 validity stop; do not pool v1 runs. Task suffixes are part of the fixed task contract, not a treatment.
